narrativeImpact.story: One month later, Tanya is leading but operates as a bottleneck after “everything should flow through her” lands too literally, slowing decisions on Watkins Annex recovery. Ownership for the slip is assigned, yet assumptions keep resurfacing because roles and escalation paths remain vague in practice. Karl attends weekly check-ins and completes delivery courses, but stays guarded about reporting lines. You are seen as addressing issues, though missing sharper alignment.
narrativeImpact.title: Choppy Waters
narrativeImpact.description: Weeks later, Tanya is steady but hesitant to stretch further and Karl remains disengaged, and although you addressed the immediate issue, the team sees this as a moment where stronger leadership could have changed the trajectory.

narrativeImpact.story: One month later, your roles email has reduced confusion on hand-offs, and Tanya is performing the clarity-and-consistency checks, but she stays cautious about scope creep and relies on weekly guardrails. Karl follows the new budget and schedule snapshot routine inconsistently and remains distant in meetings. Churchill Group comments improve, yet Watkins Annex milestones still slip. The team sees progress, but also a missed chance for firmer leadership.
